group_manifest.proof_strategy: For each target unfold its goal definition and select the first outer disjunct. Introduce binders, rewrite the explicit equality hypotheses, unfold only xizi_double_link_call_empty_result/null_result/len_result, xizi_double_link_first_value, or xizi_double_link_singleton_nodes as applicable, construct the pure conjunction, and close the unchanged xizi_dll entailment by standard separation-logic cancellation. Do not attempt the diagnostic-only alternate xizi_dllseg branch.

group_entry.proof_strategy: For each target unfold its goal definition and select the first outer disjunct. Introduce binders, rewrite the explicit equality hypotheses, unfold only xizi_double_link_call_empty_result/null_result/len_result, xizi_double_link_first_value, or xizi_double_link_singleton_nodes as applicable, construct the pure conjunction, and close the unchanged xizi_dll entailment by standard separation-logic cancellation. Do not attempt the diagnostic-only alternate xizi_dllseg branch.
group_entry.natural_language_proof_strategy: The standalone weak specs already produce exact nil and return-value facts. These facts make each wrapper postcondition a definitional restatement of the first generated branch while ownership is unchanged.
group_entry.grouping_reason: Same init-callpoint family, same full-resource branch selection, same definitional rewrite/cancel proof pattern, no helpers or dependencies, and 9 witnesses is within max_witnesses_per_group=12.

per_witness_plan.proof_of_xizi_double_link_call_head_afte: First disjunct; unfold null_result; use retval=0; preserve xizi_dll nil.
per_witness_plan.proof_of_xizi_double_link_call_len_after: First disjunct; unfold len_result; use retval=0; preserve xizi_dll nil.
per_witness_plan.proof_of_xizi_double_link_call_next_afte: First disjunct; substitute nodes=nil; simplify first_value; use retval=0; preserve xizi_dll nil.
per_witness_plan.proof_of_xizi_double_link_call_insert_af: First disjunct; substitute nodes=nil; unfold singleton_nodes; preserve the singleton xizi_dll.
